item: #18 (leaf-initialization family) — Phase 0: the m22 collapse diagnosis (mechanism only)
commit: b09ff7a (plan15 committed at d7de659 + plan file; the Phase-0 instrumentation is temporary and reverted — `git diff --exit-code` verified clean after the revert, release build re-verified)
probe: temporary env-gated instrumentation ported from the archived reexam probe.patch (bb19e7b) to HEAD: src/search/probe.rs (counters C1-C8 + plan15 additions: children-per-frame histogram, evals-by-ply buckets, bounded 2^26-slot unique-key set; arms behind PROBE_INIT=mob|mob-or|mob-and|mobcap8|moblog; P2 trace behind PROBE_TRACE) + hooks in children.rs / core.rs / dfpn/mod.rs / search/mod.rs + examples/probe_solve.rs; all reverted (files deleted, no trace remains)

run_grid.anchor_a: pristine product CLI before instrumentation: m22/dec13/dec10/dec15 at salt 0, --tt-size 128 --first-outcome --outcome-only --budget 1000000000 --timeout 600 (plan12 salt-0 identity)

run_grid.p1: base + mob arms x {stress, m22, dec13, dec10} at salt 0; budgets stress 2.5 B, others 1 B

soundness_invariants.a_probe_disabled_identity: PASS: pristine product CLI reproduces plan12 salt-0 counts exactly before and after the instrumented runs (m22 14,156,269 / dec13 3,822,602 / dec10 4,262,128 / dec15 1,077,420; stdout byte-identical; stderr differs only in wall-clock elapsed/nps annotations)
soundness_invariants.b_probe_enabled_nonperturbation: PASS: counter-only probe arm reproduces the same four counts exactly
soundness_invariants.c_outcomes: PASS: every uncensored run reports win; every censored run is draw + BudgetExhausted (no-result sentinel)
soundness_invariants.d_determinism: PASS: two reruns (base, mob-or on m22 salt 0) identical bit-for-bit modulo wall_s
soundness_invariants.e_revert: PASS: `git diff --exit-code` clean, release build re-verified, anchors re-run exact

verdict: GO-plan16: two sub-arms qualify (mob-or, mobcap8) — stress-or-dec13 direction win (<= 0.9) AND m22 <= 1.5x baseline uncensored on 3/3 salts; mob-and and moblog retired; the collapse is carried by the AND-side (1, n) init, the win by the OR-side (n, 1) init
notes: Raw transcripts and P2 traces (*.out, *.err, *.trace under RAW=/tmp/plan15/raw) are not committed per the AGENTS.md measurement layout; probe15.py regenerates them deterministically.

The unique-node key set (2^26 slots, ~512 MB, insert-only, saturating at 3/4 load) is a temporary probe-only exception to 'RAM = TT only', same status as the preflight REGION_BUDGET; it never perturbs the trajectory (invariant b).

Descendant-eval counters (ply_evals, explored_evals_after, first_sweep_cut_evals, exit_*_evals) overlap across nesting (reexam caveat): ply tables show where deep recursion happens, not additive work.

All ratio readings are below the pinned gate's noise floor on the quiet band [0.76, 1.32]; m22 readings are systematic (3 salts per arm), stress/dec13/dec10 readings are single-draw hypothesis-ranking data, not lever verdicts. plan16 re-measures every nominated shape under the paired-salt rule.
